summary: This paper resolves three prominent open problems regarding Gaussian steering saturation, CHSH nonlocality, and heralded Wigner negativity in multimode quantum networks. First, the author constructs an explicit rank-1 dual steering witness on the one-photon filtered two-qubit subspace, analytically proving 3k-1 three-setting steering saturation for all k >= 1 and establishing exact equatorial n-setting thresholds (such as 4/13 for n=4). Second, by pairing neighbor bucket measurements with node displacement settings, the work establishes a non-asymptotic CHSH bound achieving a 16x asymptotic sharpening over prior literature. Third, exact Fock-Bargmann frame-permanent identities and cyclotomic Galois invariance prove rationality of frame normalizations, accompanied by parity-split Wigner bounds and exact heralding rate asymptotics. All core results are fully verified in constructive Lean 4 with zero-float rational certificates.
